scene.title: Forces on a sliding block
scene.summary: Visualize weight, normal, friction and net acceleration for a block on a ramp.

beats.title: Ramp and block
beats.narration: A block sits halfway down a 30° ramp.

beats.title: Weight vector
beats.narration: Gravity pulls straight down with weight W.

beats.title: Normal force
beats.narration: The ramp pushes back with a normal force N perpendicular to the surface.

beats.title: Friction force
beats.narration: Friction f acts up the slope opposing motion.

beats.title: Net acceleration
beats.narration: The remaining force gives acceleration a as shown.
